Gorson Bugyal - Uttarkhand, 

Gorson Bugyal is one of Uttarakhand’s most scenic alpine meadows, located at an altitude of approximately 3,000 meters in the Chamoli district, just a short distance from Auli. The word “Bugyal” means high-altitude meadow, and Gorson Bugyal truly lives up to its name with vast green expanses, gentle rolling hills, and panoramic views of the Himalayan peaks including Nanda Devi and Mana Peak.

This meadow is perfect for trekking, nature photography, and camping, offering a peaceful escape from the crowded tourist spots. In summer, the meadow is lush green and dotted with wildflowers, while in winter, it transforms into a snowy wonderland, ideal for skiing practice or simply enjoying the snow.

Gorson Bugyal is also a favorite among adventure enthusiasts, photographers, and families, as it combines easy trekking trails with breathtaking natural beauty. It’s one of the best spots to watch sunsets and sunrises over the Himalayas, making it a must-visit location near Auli.

Best Time to Visit:

  • April to June (Peak Season): Best for trekking, wildflowers, and panoramic views (10°C - 20°C).
  • July to September (Monsoon): Less crowded, but trails may be slippery (15°C - 22°C).
  • October to February (Winter): Snow-covered meadows, ideal for snow photography and winter activities (-3°C to 10°C).

Distance from City Center:

  • From Auli: 15 km
  • From Joshimath: 16 km
  • From Rishikesh: 270 km
  • From Dehradun Airport: 280 km

🎟️ Tickets & Entry Fee: (Approx)

  • Trekking Guide (optional): ₹500–₹1,000 depending on group size.
  • Camping Charges (if applicable): ₹1,000 - ₹2,500 per night.

Things to Do in Gorson Bugyal:

  • Trek through the lush green meadows with Himalayan backdrops.
  • Enjoy camping under the stars in summer or winter.
  • Watch sunrise and sunset over Nanda Devi and Mana Peaks.
  • Photograph wildflowers in spring and snow landscapes in winter.
  • Combine your visit with Auli skiing or cable car rides.
  • Explore nearby Joshimath temples and local markets.
  • Try picnicking and relaxing amidst the peaceful alpine setting.

Top 5 Places to Visit Near Gorson Bugyal (within 50 km):

  • Auli Ski Resort (15 km): Adventure hub with skiing and cable car rides, Read more …
  • Joshimath (16 km): Religious and cultural town.
  • Nanda Devi Viewpoint (10 km): Stunning panoramic view of the peak.
  • Kalpeshwar Temple (50 km): Important Himalayan pilgrimage site.
  • Mana Village (40 km): Scenic village near the Indo-Tibetan border.
excerpt: Gorson Bugyal is a must-visit alpine meadow near Auli, offering tranquil natural beauty, trekking trails, and stunning Himalayan views. Perfect for families, nature lovers, and adventure seekers, it’s a destination where you can camp, photograph, and soak in the serene landscapes. Combine it with nearby attractions like Auli, Joshimath, Badrinath, and Mana Village for a complete Uttarakhand experience.

faqs.question: How difficult is the trek to Gorson Bugyal?
faqs.answer: The trek to Gorson Bugyal is moderate in difficulty, making it suitable for beginners, families, and casual hikers. The trails are well-marked, and the gradual incline allows visitors to enjoy the lush alpine meadows and Himalayan panoramas without much strain.

faqs.question: Local guides available for trekking?
faqs.answer: Yes, experienced local guides are available in Joshimath and Auli. They can help navigate trails safely, provide information about the flora, fauna, and Himalayan peaks, and enhance the overall trekking experience.

faqs.question: How far is Gorson Bugyal from Auli and Joshimath?
faqs.answer: Gorson Bugyal is approximately 15 km from Auli and 16 km from Joshimath. The distance is easily covered via a short trek or road route, making it perfect for a day trip or combined adventure with Auli skiing.

faqs.question: How much time should I plan to spend in Gorson Bugyal?
faqs.answer: 2-5 hours enough for exploring the meadow, trekking, and taking photographs. For those camping or enjoying a relaxed picnic, staying overnight adds more time to fully enjoy the natural beauty.

faqs.question: When is the best time to visit Gorson Bugyal?
faqs.answer: Best time to visit Gorson Bugyal is from April to June for vibrant wildflowers and green meadows. For snow enthusiasts and winter photography, December to February is ideal when the entire meadow is covered in snow, creating a magical landscape.
